name: scoutjobs
description: Job search operating system for the job seeker: search Greenhouse, Lever, Ashby, Workable, SmartRecruiters, Personio, RSS and remote boards, score fit, check your CV, tailor applications, prep and mock interviews, learn from your decisions, track it all on a local dashboard with a JSON API and an MCP server for n8n and other agents; scoutjobs doctor checks the install.
